name: Kortexify
description: **Kortexify** is a local-first, AI-augmented academic engine designed to turn raw course materials into long-term subject mastery in a single document drop. Built on a zero-latency offline architecture, it pairs multimodal STEM OCR with local vector RAG to instantly convert complex textbook chapters, hand-written equations, and lecture slides into deeply contextual answers anchored to your source files. By automatically synthesizing unstructured notes into intelligent active-recall prompts and scheduling them through adaptive spaced repetition, Kortexify creates an all-in-one workspace where deep understanding and effortless retention happen in parallel.
